atomicity.reason: One obligation: support MCS charging sessions.

feasibility.reason: MCS hardware exists for heavy trucks.

parent_fit.reason: MCS enables megawatt-level depot charging within a driver break (US_FAST_DEPOT_CHARGING).

unambiguity.reason: Single reading: the vehicle can conduct MCS charging sessions.

variant_consistency.reason: Gated by spelled-out mcs condition (var.charging.mcs == True); in the product data MCS only occurs with bev, so it is never present without its bev-gated parent. Note it is not nested in the bev block, so this relies on that data invariant.

verifiability.reason: Testable as an MCS session, but no standard reference/version (e.g. IEC 63379 / SAE J3271) defines the pass criteria.
verifiability.suggestion: Reference the MCS standard and edition the vehicle shall conform to.
